name: anstar-business-central
description: Read-only Business Central Production adapter with personal Microsoft sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Anstar-owned TypeScript adapter to Microsoft's hosted Business Central MCP. First use starts personal Microsoft sign-in if needed. Read-only dynamic discovery targets Production / Anstar Ltd. Requires Node.js 22+ and npm/npx; dependencies install automatically.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Business Central read-only connection is ready.
Find the available Business Central APIs for my question without changing any records.
